name: spx-jev label spec
purpose: Every label the SPX state builder writes, with the logic and cut under it. Built labels are checked against the code by a test; lane labels are written by the tape lane only. Cut names are the constants in spx_jev/cuts.py and the label families (spx_jev/labels/); the options-book labels name the book (expiry) they describe.

statuses.built: in the label families (spx_jev/labels/) today, writing sentences
statuses.lane: written by the tape lane only: a read on the bar clock, never by the live lane

types.distance: how far, in sigma, today's expected move (tape labels: tape units)
types.rank: where it sits against its own history at the same time of day
types.share: one part against the whole, or one window against another
types.state: which of a few named situations

how_one_label_is_built: pick the moment: one diary row is now, plus only the minutes that had already closed
take the raw numbers untouched (row_adapter keeps only the fields named); if one is missing, stop and record why
put the number on a scale: divide by sigma, or rank it against past sessions at this clock time
judge it against a cut from cuts.py, in code
write one sentence that carries the number, the cut and, for the options book, which expiry it describes
hand it to the packer, which gives each question only the sentences it names

viewpoints.title: The strikes and the books: weight, walls, which expiry holds them
Price action (SPX prints no volume of its own)
Yesterday, the day before, the last five sessions
RSI, implied volatility and the VIX curve
Space and time: where price sits in the day, the session and the expiry calendar
The market around SPX: NYSE breadth and the sectors

real_rows_note: real sentences come from `python3 -m spx_jev.build --day 2026-09-25 --at 12:45` (and `--at 09:50 --lane tape` for the tape range); where nothing on disk could show a label (the breadth labels before any market-context snapshot, the move since the last read on a first read), real is null and reads_as is the test fixture's sentence; the two flow labels' real sentences come from 2026-09-24 (09:45 for the options tape, 10:50 for the one judged wall touch that day)
